title: Grant of a position of the loop, version 0
description: One file per position, <state>/grants/<position>.json. Whoever configures the project writes it; the loop only reads it. The switch of a position is not here: it is state of the loop. validate-grants.py checks what the schema does not express: the file name equals the position, no position is called `human`, exactly one root, every parent exists, no cycle, no parameter named as a placeholder of the loop, no parameter on the root.

position.description: The id of the position; equal to the file name without `.json`.

parent.description: The position that receives the escalations of this one, and that can ask spawns on it. `human` for the root: an escalation from the root becomes an interpellation of the human.

max_sessions.description: How many sessions of this position can be alive at the same time. A spawn over the cap waits in the queue.

budget_tokens.description: The tokens that all the sessions of the position, alive and closed, can spend together. Over the budget the loop switches the position off and stops its sessions.

parameters.description: The parameters that whoever asks a spawn on the position must pass, `name=value`, each from a closed list of values. Every declared parameter is required, and a position with parameters takes no free text in its spawn. In `prompt`, `allowed_tools` and `command` the loop replaces {name} with the value chosen. Absent: the spawn takes no parameter and accepts a free text, as before.

values.description: The closed list of the values allowed. A value ends up inside a permission rule, so it takes only letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen: a space or a `*` would change the meaning of the rule.

launch.description: How the loop launches a session of the position. An absent field takes the most closed value: safe mode on, Bash only, in Bash only the request command, dontAsk, an empty directory under the state root. In `prompt`, `allowed_tools` and `command` the loop replaces {request}, {code}, {state}, {session}, {position} and the parameters of the grant.

type.description: llm: a background Claude Code session · script: a local process, for the tests

command.description: Only script: the command line of the process.

tools.description: Only llm: the built-in tools of the session. Default ["Bash"]; [] for none.

allowed_tools.description: Only llm: the permission rules allowed without asking. Default ["Bash(<request command> *)"].

model.description: Only llm. Default: the default model of Claude Code.

cwd.description: The working directory of the sessions; relative to the state root. Default: an empty directory per session under <state>/loop/work/.
